name: Prestone
summary: Antifreeze and coolant from the brand that introduced it to American drivers.
description: Prestone makes antifreeze and coolant, along with brake fluid, washer fluid, de-icers and cooling-system maintenance products for cars, heavy-duty vehicles and EVs.
facts: Introduced the first non-flammable ethylene glycol antifreeze in 1927.
Describes itself as North America's no. 1 provider of antifreeze and coolant.

name: BIZOL
summary: German motor oils, transmission fluids and professional-grade additives.
description: BIZOL is a Berlin-born brand of motor oils, gear and transmission fluids, additives, technical sprays and service fluids for cars, motorcycles and trucks.
facts: Sold in more than 70 countries.
Won the Red Dot Design Award in 2014 and the iF Design Award in 2015 for its packaging.

name: Redex
summary: Petrol and diesel fuel-system additives, trusted by British drivers since 1922.
description: Redex makes petrol and diesel fuel-system additives, including injector cleaners, along with oil treatments and fuel cans.
facts: Has been keeping drivers on the road since 1922.
Known in Britain for its “penny a shot” dispensers on filling-station forecourts.

name: Holts
summary: Car maintenance and emergency repair products. Problem solved.
description: Holts makes car maintenance and emergency repair products: maintenance sprays, exhaust and radiator leak repair, tyre repair, screen wash, de-icers and cleaning products.
facts: Solving car problems since 1919, when Douglas Holt first started selling car parts.
Develops, tests and manufactures in the UK for export around the world.

name: Simoniz
summary: Car cleaning and care with more than a century of shine behind it.
description: Simoniz makes car cleaning and care products: shampoos, waxes and polishes, glass, wheel and trim cleaners, and interior care.
facts: Founded in 1910. By the 1930s, “to Simoniz” had become a verb for polishing a car to a high shine.
Today its products are developed in Manchester, England.

name: Adam's Polishes
summary: Premium American detailing: washes, polishes, ceramic and graphene coatings.
description: Adam's Polishes makes car detailing chemicals and accessories for exterior and interior care: washes, polishes, waxes, ceramic and graphene coatings, towels and tools.
facts: Founded by Adam Pitale in California in 2000, and now based in Colorado.

name: NILOS
summary: German-made adhesives, vulcanising materials and patches for conveyor belt repair.
description: NILOS produces adhesives, vulcanising materials and repair patches for conveyor belts and rubber repair, for both hot and cold vulcanisation.
facts: Based in Hilden, Germany, and active since 1926.
Products are made in Germany.

name: Dura-Vulc
summary: A complete tyre repair line: patches, strings, cements and tools.
description: Dura-Vulc is a full line of tyre repair materials: patches and repair units, string inserts, cements and chemicals, and repair tools.
facts: Launched in 2014 by Dorian Drake International of New York.
Its promise: quality without compromise.

name: KACO
summary: German sealing systems: oil seals, shaft seals and gaskets.
description: KACO develops sealing systems for automotive and industrial use, including radial shaft seals, static seals and gaskets, with a dedicated aftermarket programme.
facts: Founded in 1914, with more than a century of sealing expertise.
An original-equipment supplier to the automotive industry.

name: MTE-THOMSON
summary: Thermostats and engine-management sensors. Temperature and emissions under control.
description: MTE-THOMSON manufactures engine temperature and engine-management parts: coolant thermostats, temperature sensors and switches, oxygen sensors, and MAP, TPS and rotation sensors.
facts: Began in 1957, as Brazil's own automobile industry was getting started.

name: TOTACHI
summary: Motor oils, fluids and engine consumables from Japan.
description: TOTACHI offers motor oils, lubricants and special fluids from Japan, alongside automotive filters, brake pads, wiper blades, coolants and batteries.
facts: Founded in 1998 by a group of chemical engineers in Hokkaido, Japan.
Distributed in more than thirty markets worldwide.

name: Veedol
summary: The professional's choice in motor oil for over a century.
description: Veedol covers engine oils for passenger cars, motorcycles and commercial vehicles, plus gear and transmission oils, greases and specialities.
facts: Created in the USA in 1913 by Tide Water Associated Oil.
According to the brand, it was the first engine oil chosen by Henry Ford for the Model T.
Marketed in over 70 countries.

name: Duckhams
summary: The original British motor oil, since 1899.
description: Duckhams makes engine oils for modern cars, classic cars and motorcycles, plus brake and clutch fluid, gear oils and transmission fluids.
facts: Founded in London in 1899 by Alexander Duckham.
According to the brand, it launched Europe's first multigrade motor oil, Duckhams Q20-50, in 1951.

name: LUBEGARD
summary: Transmission additives and fluids relied on by professional workshops.
description: LUBEGARD makes transmission fluid additives, transmission and power-steering fluids, and additives for engines, cooling systems and gears.
ranges: COMPLETE fluids (ATF, CVT, DCT, power steering)
facts: Built on LXE (liquid wax ester) chemistry, developed as a renewable replacement for sperm whale oil.
Made in the USA by International Lubricants, Inc., with more than 40 years in the business.

name: Emarat
summary: Engine oils, industrial lubricants and greases made in the UAE.
description: Emarat lubricants cover petrol and diesel engine oils, motorcycle and marine oils, hydraulic, gear, transmission and industrial oils, greases, coolants and brake fluids.
facts: Emirates General Petroleum Corporation (Emarat) was established in the UAE in 1981.
Its lubricants are manufactured in Jebel Ali, UAE, and exported to the Gulf, Africa and Asia.

name: REMA TIP TOP
summary: Tyre repair systems from the German specialist: patches, materials, tools and equipment.
description: REMA TIP TOP makes tyre repair systems: repair patches and materials, tools and vulcanising equipment for almost every type of tyre and damage.
facts: Founded in 1923 by Otto and Willy Gruber. The TIP TOP brand name dates from 1938.
Describes itself as the world's leading manufacturer of tyre repair systems, represented in more than 180 countries.
